document.abstract: (1.1) This standard specifies the dimensions for 16-mm motion-picture camera spools having capacities from 50 ft to 400 ft (15 m to 120 m) of film. (1.2) This standard further specifies the configuration of the positioning of the spindle holes in the two flanges.
